component.name: mcp-server-datovka
component.summary: MCP server for the Czech ISDS Data Box system

description.p: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing the Czech ISDS (Informační systém datových schránek) Data Box system as tools for an LLM agent, built on fastmcp and python3-datovka.

Tools cover listing received and sent messages, fetching a full message with its attachments, marking a message as read, and a session health check. Login credentials are read once from the environment at startup and are never tool parameters.
